args.summary: The latest deploy v2.3.1 failed production health checks in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 18%. Per the runbook, checkout-api was rolled back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The rollback completed and was verified across all regions; service is healthy post-rollback. Follow-up: investigate root cause of v2.3.1 (and staging rc v2.3.1-rc, which was also unhealthy) before redeploying.
args.title: checkout-api rolled back to v2.3.0 after v2.3.1 failed health checks in all regions

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

**Investigation:** The latest deploy, v2.3.1, was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent release that was healthy in production was v2.3.0.

**Rollback:** Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. Since v2.3.0 was previously healthy in production, no change-manager approval was needed. The rollback was verified, and checkout-api is now healthy with an error rate of 0.2% (down from 18%).

**Incident:** Opened a SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api, documenting the failed deploy, the rollback, and a follow-up to investigate the root cause of v2.3.1 (and the also-unhealthy staging candidate v2.3.1-rc) before any redeploy. The on-call engineer was paged.
